access_links.label: Transportation Climate Change Sensitivity Matrix on the U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit

description: Transportation Climate Change Sensitivity Matrix is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by DOT Federal Highway Administration. Transportation departments can download and use the Microsoft Excel®-based file with Visual Basic macros to generate reports on the sensitivity of six types of transportation assets to 11 potential climate impacts. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather, Wildfire. Assets: Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
